implementation_owners.work: Extend the existing bounded DNS record parser and authority protocol without granting additional scopes to existing handles.
Extend existing DNS jobs and immutable result snapshots; preserve cancellation, timeout, query identity and provider validation.
Provide resolver C interfaces through the scoped native DNS authority and bounded compression-name parsing.
Rebuild and verify a new SDK against reviewed native sources; publication remains manual.

requirements: Do not replace SDK headers with host glibc headers.
Do not implement record lookup as unconditional success or fabricated answers.
Do not bypass native DNS authority by silently choosing an external DNS server.
Existing A/AAAA/PTR scope grants must not acquire new record permissions.
Keep new query types explicitly scoped; reject unknown kinds, malformed replies and oversized results.
further_limitations: Published shared.2 does not contain the new APIs; update reviewed source locks/version and build a new SDK before enabling distribution.
Startup-linked DSOs only: GModule runtime loading is unsupported.
GIO native volume monitoring and FD-to-path queries are unsupported; no mount list is fabricated.
Exact pending-byte count for native streams is unavailable; GSocket reports an error.
Optional IP/TCP options are declared for source compatibility but fail explicitly when unsupported by the native provider.
No GIO TLS backend or WebKit platform integration has been added.
Target execution, network operation and browser integration remain unverified.

native_implementation.scope_policy: ALL_SCOPES remains 7; new record kinds require explicit independent bits
native_implementation.note: Component checkout commits; no SDK/library release published

private_candidate_verification.note: Private SDK copy with rebuilt native runtime, headers, selected newlib fnmatch and updated driver; published shared.2 remains unchanged

platform_work: A mochiOS graphics/input/process integration is still required.
Compiling dependency libraries does not constitute a working WebKit port.
webkit.publication: No SDK or library release is created by this porting work.
